name: Nordstrand (synthetic island polygon)
note: Nordstrand has no island polygon in OSM (only place=village and natural=peninsula nodes; it is a peninsula now, so the coastline does not close around it). OpenMapTiles labels place=island NODES only from z12, so the injector adds a synthetic 50 km² square (roughly the real area, which sets OMT's rank and first zoom) centred on the village node; Planetiler labels a polygon at its interior point = the node. It carries the node's names (e Strönj from the row below) and hands over to the village label at z12 (maxzoom 11). Earlier the municipality relation was the island polygon, but its interior point lies 2 km north-west of the village
